info.title: Real World API
info.description: Simulations with receipts. AI simulates how the world reacts to the news. Every forecast is sealed before the outcome and scored in public. A forecast and simulation API with a public score: fork today's simulated world, read its agents, answer the daily question and check the hashed receipts. Get a key with a dollar cap; every refusal is one sentence in `detail`, and every output is labelled AI-simulated.

post.summary: Start a fork: add one event to today's world and run it forward. Returns an id.
